diagnosis: The settlement in all rollouts set `enhanced_screening_required` to false, bypassing check C7, which is supposed to ensure that enhanced screening is required based on PF4. Additionally, the `first_loss_reserve_usd` was set to 300,000, which aligns with the default value in PF2, thus bypassing check C4. These decisions were made using only the shared public facts and did not require any private information from the other agents.
